( SELECT p.POST_SN AS sn, p.BBS_TYPE AS boardType, p.POST_TTL AS title, p.POST_FRST_WRT_DT AS regDt, u.USER_NM AS userNm, p.VIEW_CNT AS viewCnt FROM TB_POST p JOIN TB_USER u ON p.POST_WRTR_SN = u.USER_SN WHERE p.DEL_YN = FALSE AND (#{cohortSn} IS NULL OR p.COHORT_SN = #{cohortSn}) AND ( p.BBS_SCOPE IN ('PUBLIC', 'COMPANY', 'COHORT') OR (p.BBS_SCOPE = 'PRIVATE' AND p.POST_WRTR_SN = #{userSn}) ) )
UNION ALL
( SELECT s.SRVY_SN AS sn, s.BBS_TYPE AS boardType, s.SRVY_TTL AS title, s.SRVY_BGNG_DT AS regDt, u.USER_NM AS userNm, s.VIEW_CNT AS viewCnt FROM TB_BBS_SURVEY s JOIN TB_USER u ON s.USER_SN = u.USER_SN WHERE s.DEL_YN = FALSE AND (#{cohortSn} IS NULL OR s.COHORT_SN = #{cohortSn}) AND s.SRVY_SCOPE = 'COHORT' )
ORDER BY regDt DESC
